text:
Accepted blocking alternative implemented. FiguresHost shows MethodsVM's existing status or its unavailable-text reason beside the disabled editor, while no-figure heading does not acquire a duplicate status. Private typed MethodsStatus distinguishes transient GenerationUnavailable from author-action Message; Regenerate while data is unavailable follows current availability and clears once generation becomes ready, without using English text as identity. Public MethodsVM.status remains Option[String]; no persisted/scientific/schema changes.
Actual-host regression gates only FigureInputs.methods delivery while delegating genuine facts and other reads to the existing session helper. It proves disabled editor plus visible loading/refusal reason before facts, genuine readiness enables actual keyboard editing, and later genuine callbacks retain authored text. It also checks loading Regenerate/recovery leaves no stale Reading and no-figure status is not duplicated. Root pure regressions cover all six summary/report/facts arrival orders, edit recovery and regeneration choice.
Strict JDK25 qualification: MethodsGeneratorSuite19/19 JVM and19/19 JS; FigureMethodsFxSuite6/6 headless, no ignored tests; desktop main/Test compiled with-Werror. All four modified source/test files formatted. Log /private/tmp/eyes4s-methods-load-safety-focused.log. Source is frozen for independent parent review and landing checks; no closure claim made here.
